<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2 and the molecular formula C₆H₉O₂ (C=6, H=9, N=0, X=0), the calculation gives DBE = (12 + 2 – 9) / 2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the nearest whole‑number value is 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
